questions.question: In an organization consisting of 214 employees, 120 have participated in Clay Modelling and 130 have participated in Poster Making, 36 employees have participated in both Clay Modelling and Poster Making. If each employee has participated in at least one of the two activities, how many employees participated in Poster Making only?
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given information is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8522e9ab112dd4cfeca511c37b5e8dae043f4e5aece4cf8758d8332f089d93f.png] 

Given, Total number of employees in an organization = 214 employees.

Number of employees participated in clay modelling = 120

Number of employees participated in poster making = 130

Number of employees participated in both clay modelling and poster making = 36

So, Number of employees participated in clay modelling only = Number of employees participated in clay modelling - Number of employees participated in both clay modelling and poster making

So, Number of employees participated in **c****lay modelling only** = 120 - 36

So, Number of employees participated in **c****lay modelling only =** 84

Similarly,

Number of employees participated in poster making only = Number of employees participated in poster making - Number of employees participated in both clay modelling and poster making

Number of employees participated in **poster making only** = 130 - 36

∴ Number of employees participated in** poster making only = 94**

Total employees = Number of employees participated in clay modelling only + Number of employees participated in poster making only + Number of employees participated in both clay modelling and poster making 

Total employees = 84 + 94 + 36

Total employees = 214 employees.

∴ Here, Number of employees participated in poster making only is '94'.

Hence, the correct answer is** "94".**

If 'A' denotes 'addition', 'B' denotes 'multiplication', 'C' denotes 'subtraction', and 'D' denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following expression?

90 D (2 B 5) A 4 B (12 A 10) C 4 B (17 C 10)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

'A' denotes 'addition', 'B' denotes 'multiplication', 'C' denotes 'subtraction', and 'D' denotes 'division',

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 **Symbol**
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

Given equation : 90 D (2 B 5) A 4 B (12 A 10) C 4 B (17 C 10)

After replacing the symbols instead of alphabets in given equation is as follows : 90 ÷ (2 × 5) + 4 × (12 + 10) - 4 × (17 - 10)

= 90 ÷ __**(2 × 5)**__ + 4 × __**(12 + 10)**__ - 4 × __**(17 - 10)**__

= __**90 ÷ 10**__ + 4 × 22 - 4 × 7

= 9 + __**4 × 22**__ - __**4 × 7**__

= __**9 + 88**__ - 28

= __**97 - 28**__

**= 69**

Hence, the correct answer is **"69".**

questions.question: GDP can be expressed in two different ways, nominal GDP and _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**real GDP.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Real gross domestic product (real GDP) is an** inflation-adjusted measure** that reflects the value of **all goods and services** produced by an economy in a given year (expressed in base-year prices).
 
• Real GDP tracks the** total value of goods and services **by calculating the quantities but using constant prices that are adjusted for inflation.
 
• **Nominal GDP** = Real GDP x GDP Deflator.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• GDP-gross domestic product; the **total value of all the goods and services** produced in a country in **one year**.
 
• GDP is important because it gives information about the size of the economy and how an economy is performing.
 
• Four types of GDP- **Real GDP, Nominal GDP, Actual GDP, and Potential GDP**.
 
• Nominal GDP-Nominal GDP is an **assessment of economic production** in an economy that includes current prices in its calculation.
 
• Potential GDP-In economics, potential output refers to the highest level of real gross domestic product that can be sustained over the long term.​
